text:
ashley: starting a config-only deploy now. Changes: routing timeout 1500ms -> 1200ms, batch_size cap 32 -> 24, per-tenant surge_cap 200 -> 180. canary: 2% traffic for 30m. docs updated in the release notes.

deploy-bot: queued: config-only change id cfg-20260323-7. Initiating canary rollout. Expected RTT impact: small.

chris: ack. Watching latency dashboards and kvcache pressure. Will ping if p50 shifts > 10%.

santhosh: quick question — are we pinning model variants for the canary or letting smart-routing pick?

ashley: pinning to v2.3-infer for canary only, so fallback remains when we widen. Add note in release notes.

kyle: small nit: reduce request timeout propagation in client SDK too? Some SDKs default to 1.8s. We should avoid client-side 1.5s cutoffs.

ashley: good call. opsbot, can you kick a doc patch for SDK timeout guidance?

opsbot: created PR #942 in devex/docs: "Client timeouts during config-only routing-timeout rollouts".

chris: seeing a tiny uptick in tail latency on a small subset — 95th moved +6% at 2m in. No error increase. Holding on deeper dive.

santhosh: checking kvcache hitrate. If kvcache drops >5% we should pause.

deploy-bot: canary at 2% -> 5% (after 10m) per schedule. Autoscale policy unchanged.

kyle: infra note: I temporarily increased slot drain window to 80s to avoid spiky evictions during the rollout.

chris: confirmed kvcache hitrate steady at -1.2%. CPU and GPU utilization nominal.

ashley: proceeding to widen to 10% at 20m per plan. Rolling notes: if p50 > 15% or kvcache hitrate delta >5% or error rate >0.2% absolute, rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: warming to 10% complete. Telemetry hooks set: /deploys/cfg-20260323-7/streams.

santhosh: ran a quick synthetic workload against the canary. No correctness regressions.

chris: small consumer with low qps reported 504s twice — looking into client timeout interplay. Not systemic yet.

ashley: decision: leave canary at 10% and pause widen until we sort client-side timeouts. Not rolling to 50% yet.

kyle: agree. I'll send an email to the SDK leads to push the timeout guidance patch.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by request of ashley. Current traffic: 10%. Stay watch.

ashley: rollback criteria still active. If we don't get SDK guidance out in 2 hours, we revert this change.

chris: adding an observability snippet to the release notes so on-call can see the exact metrics to watch: ```
mon query: avg(p50_latency) by model,route
mon query: kvcache.hitrate.delta(10m)
mon query: errors.count(total) / requests.count(total)
```

santhosh: also tagging the change with tenant-exempt list (internal test tenants) so we can simulate more without impacting customers.

ashley: final: release notes updated, canary pinned to v2.3-infer, paused at 10%, rollback plan in the thread. Thanks all — shout if you see anything. :thumbsup:
